10Investment Highlights
❖Unique Travel Theme Decorations
“Rich in Unique Concepts Under the ‘Terminal 21’ Brand ” Terminal 21 Asok and Terminal 21 Pattaya are decorated in the style of popular destinations from cities around the World with iconic landmarks recreated inside 
the mall, offering visitors a fun and visually interesting shopping experience.
❖Diverse Shopping Options
Offers a wide variety of shopping options for all tastes and budget 
levels ranging from notable designer brands to local fashion boutiques 
and souvenir shops which can attract both local and foreign shoppers.❖Food Magnets
In addition to having a dedicated floors for Thai and International 
cuisines and cafes, both malls also offer a large Food Court area 
which is known for their affordable and delicious Thai local 
dishes and street food and desserts.

18Stable Financial Performance
Financial Information : FY2025
❖Total revenue increased primarily due to the improved operating 
performance of the shopping malls, the full -year revenue 
recognition from the additional investment in Terminal 21 Pattaya, 
and higher interest income from increased investments in liquid 
assets.
❖Total costs rose compared to the previous year, mainly driven by 
higher finance costs from long -term borrowings related to the 
Terminal 21 Pattaya acquisition. Additionally, operating expenses 
and fees increased in line with the Trust’s expanded asset size.
❖The net increase in net assets resulted from enhanced operating 
performance across shopping centers and the recognition of 
unrealized gains from the 2025 annual fair value valuation of 
investment properties, which saw a broad upward adjustment.
❖Consequently ,netprofit on investment grew by 70.7% year-on-year.Key Summary :
